raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related components previously moved to stricter controls. Exporters should re-verify ECCN classification, license requirements, and destination-based controls, as well as HTS alignment and Section 301 tariff exposure for US-bound or re-exported goods. Entity List and restricted party screening remains mandatory, and end-use/end-user statements should be retained. Note that this change affects US export controls; China-origin exporters shipping to or through the US must still comply with US re-export rules and Chinese dual-use export control law.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口管制规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及相关零部件的原有出口管制待遇。此前被收紧管制的部分半自动枪支及相关部件，其许可负担有所降低。出口商应重新核实ECCN分类、许可要求及目的地管制，同时关注美国HTS归类及301关税风险。实体清单及受限方筛查仍为强制要求，并应保留最终用途/最终用户声明。需注意该变化针对美国出口管制；中国原产出口商向美国发运或经美国转运，仍须遵守美国再出口规则及中国两用物项出口管制法。

checklist.desc: Re-check ECCN for firearms, parts, and ammunition after the rule rescission; confirm whether a license exception or NLR applies and document the classification basis.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all parties (consignee, end-user, freight forwarder) against BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied persons lists; retain screening records.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for firearms/parts against Section 301 lists; document country of origin and value build-up to assess additional duties.
Obtain and retain a signed non-transferable end-use/end-user statement covering civilian use and prohibiting diversion to military or embargoed destinations.
Verify destination-specific controls (e.g., ITAR overlap, UN embargoes) and confirm no prohibited re-export to sanctioned countries.
